meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 这个技能会给 NanoClaw 装上 Telegram 适配器，让它能连到你创建的 Telegram 机器人。之后你需要在 Telegram 里经 BotFather 建机器人、填 token，重启并配对聊天，才能通过 Telegram 和它收发消息。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw 接到 Telegram、用机器人收发消息时使用；通常在 /setup 流程中触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 我创建完 Telegram bot 了，配对一下聊天
say.note: 引导填入 token 并运行配对步骤。

say.text: 用 Telegram 机器人测试一下连接
say.note: 重启服务并跑集成测试验证配置。

howto.what_en: Installs the Telegram adapter into NanoClaw. After setup you create a bot via BotFather, paste its token, restart, and pair your chat with a one-time 4-digit code; then you can chat over Telegram.
howto.when_en: Use this when you want to connect NanoClaw to Telegram and have the bot send/receive messages. It typically runs during NanoClaw's /setup flow or when asked to add Telegram support.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and installs the dependency.

say_en.text: I've created the Telegram bot; pair my chat now.
say_en.note: Prompts for your bot token and starts the pairing handshake.

say_en.text: Test the Telegram connection with my bot.
say_en.note: Restarts and runs the integration test to check the registration.
